svg.title: App, command, and workflow state connections
svg.desc: Inputs, outputs, durable state, evidence, failure, and recovery relationships for App, command, and workflow state.

g.text: App, command, and workflow state connections

a.xlink:title: App Catalog. Presents backend-owned app lifecycle and safe action readiness, including same-origin Open routes and Manage details.
App, command, and workflow state. Stores canonical app current/action lifecycle and workflow command/current/event state.
SQLite control-plane store. Stores canonical Lite lifecycle state and prepared projections; the frontend never accesses it directly.
App lifecycle worker. Owns install, repair, media import, backup, restore preview, update readiness/apply, and removal paths only where implemented and safe.
Workflow execution. Coordinates multi-step workflow state through bounded event admission and process-isolated projection work.
